title: Would you play a card game inspired by the chaos of software development?
author: ComfortableLoose3099
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m a solo dev and I’ve been building Hello World: Sprint Wars, a card game inspired by the daily chaos of software teams.

You pick a role with its own power, complete tasks, throw Bugs at your opponents and settle things in Merge Conflict duels. To win, you need to land the Deploy on your last card.

Modes: Classic Sprint, Points Sprint, Pipeline and Merge Conflict duels. Right now it plays offline against bots.

The Android closed beta opens soon, and I’m looking for testers. I’m also trying to decide whether online multiplayer (rooms with friends, up to 8 players) is worth building, so I’d love honest feedback on that too.

Happy to answer anything about the game or how it’s being built. And what’s the most painful bug you’ve ever shipped? 😅
